content:
Raj (support): escalating Sunsync (trial) at ~11:22 UTC. SSO callbacks failing with 403s and embedding uploads intermittently failing — demo flows blocked, customer says they may pause trials if not resolved. Need CS to coordinate comms and workaround.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-7905 \u2014 auth failures + embed errors affecting region-eu-west1. Pager notified.
Nina (csm): on it, joining. Are only admin users impacted or broader? I can draft a message for Sunsync and prep an onboarding session offer.
Ellen (support-eng): quick tail from the auth proxy/logs:
```
[11:22:11] req=/sso/callback status=403 err=invalid_assertion user_id=acct-ss-12
[11:22:30] svc=embed-uploader id=abc123 error=checksum_mismatch bytes_received=204800
```
Hints: SAML response failing validation (possible cert/metadata mismatch) and the embed upload appears truncated by proxy chunking when client uploads >200kb.
Tom (solutions): Sunsync is a prioritized renewal (due next month). Recommend temporary admin fallback (API key) so demos can proceed, plus a priority onboarding call. Offer a 1-month trial extension and a small credit for the inconvenience.
Nina (csm): draft comms for Sunsync, please edit: "Hi Sunsync team 
Thanks for flagging this. We9ve identified two issues: SSO assertions failing for some admin logins and intermittent embedding upload truncation. Our engineers are applying a metadata/cert fix and queueing retries for failed uploads. As an interim step we can provision a short-lived API key for up to 2 admins so demos can continue. We9d also like to offer a 1-month trial extension and schedule a priority onboarding call. Would you like us to enable the admin fallback now?"
Ellen (support-eng): LGTM. Tech note: to enable fallback we need approval from security, and we should log who we grant the key to. I'll prepare the patch to relax chunk handling on the proxy and trigger a reupload job.
Raj (support): DM to Sunsync: "Thanks 
We can provision admin fallback for 2 users now and schedule a priority onboarding call. Engineers are working on SSO metadata and upload retries. Does that work?"
Sunsync (external): "Yes please, enable fallback for Alice and Marco. Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll take the onboarding call next Tue AM PT."
ops-bot: ALERT UPDATED: INC-7905 mitigation in progress 
action=update metadata=saml cert=rotated region=eu-west1 time=11:35
Ellen (support-eng): follow-up checklist for postmortem/CS:
- collect SAML assertion traces and full HTTP bodies for 11:15-11:40 UTC
- list of granted admin API keys + TTL + approver
- proxy chunk settings + recent deploys
- reupload job IDs and success/failure counts
- customer-visible timeline + credits/extension confirmation
Nina (csm): I'll add this incident to Sunsync account health, flag renewal "at-risk" until postmortem is done, and owner assigned to Nina. I'll draft the follow-up email and confirm the onboarding invite once the time is set.
Tom (solutions): Also propose a follow-up: run a joint SSO test with Sunsync and a checklist to prevent metadata skew. I'll own that with Ellen.
Raj (support): Sunsync replied: "Thanks team, fallback enabled and demos working. See you Tue." Closing thread here; continuing in calendar invite.
Nina (csm): closing 
Will update renewal tracker after onboarding call and attach the incident summary to the account notes.
